# AI agent Settings

**Since mid-to-late August 2026, the AI agent page is a hub, not one long settings
screen.** Go to **AI agent** in the app menu to land on the hub, which groups every
sub-page under four headings: *What the AI knows* (Training data, Shop memory),
*How the AI behaves* (Instructions, **Skills**, **Scenarios**), *How the AI is doing*
(unresolved questions, Chatty Lab), and *Where the AI works* (**Settings**). Each of
those is now its own page with its own URL — "AI agent → Settings" below means
clicking the **Settings** card from that hub, not a tab inside a longer page.

Configure your AI agent's identity, availability, and channels at **AI agent →
Settings**. Use the **Test AI** button at the top right to preview behavior without
affecting live chat.

> **Looking for Custom Scenarios or Assistant skills (Human handover, After-sales
> support, Product recommendations, etc.)?** Those moved out of this page entirely —
> see **AI agent → Scenarios** and **AI agent → Skills** respectively. This file only
> covers what's still on the Settings page itself: identity, availability,
> re-engagement, follow-up, channels, and embed placement.

## Use Chatty as Human-Only Live Chat (Turn Off AI)

If a merchant wants to use Chatty as a pure human live chat tool with no AI involvement
at all, the answer is simple — **just deactivate the AI agent**. There is no need to
turn off AI channels one by one.

- **If the AI agent is on** → go to **AI agent** (in the app left menu), then click the
  **Deactivate** button at the top right of the page (next to Settings and Test AI).
  Once deactivated, all incoming conversations go straight to your inbox for your team
  to handle manually, and customers see no AI — the AI name and avatar only appear while
  the AI is actively responding.
- **If the AI agent was never activated** → just leave it **disabled** (the default).
  Nothing else needs to be done.

To turn AI back on later, click **Activate** on the same AI agent page.

## AI Identity

Customize the AI's name and avatar, shown to customers in conversations.
Path: **AI agent → Settings**.

- **Name**: The name shown to customers in the chatbox. Set it at
  **AI agent → Settings → Name**.
- **Avatar**: Choose a preset avatar, or upgrade to upload a custom image
- **Welcome message**: The first message customers see. Click **Insert customer name**
  to personalize it with the customer's name.

### Which "name" does the merchant mean? (three different fields)

Chatty has three separate name/identity fields. Identify which one the merchant is
pointing at before giving a path — a screenshot usually makes it obvious.

| What they want to change | Where it lives | What it affects |
|---|---|---|
| **AI agent name** — the name customers see when the AI replies | **AI agent → Settings → Name** | The AI's display name in the chatbox |
| **Team member / operator name** — the name on a human agent's profile | **Settings → Team → Manage** (edit the member) | The name customers see when a human replies |
| **Role / persona instructions** — how the AI describes itself and behaves | **AI agent → Instructions → General instructions → Role** | The AI's tone and self-description, **not** its display name |

**Common request — "make the AI introduce itself as our brand, not as an AI / not as
Chatty":** this is two settings working together.

1. Set the display name at **AI agent → Settings → Name** to the brand name.
2. Describe the persona at **AI agent → Instructions → General instructions →
   Role** (e.g. "You are the support assistant for BRAND").

Changing the Role text alone does **not** change the display name — the name field is
what customers see on the message.

### Which "welcome message" does the merchant mean? (four places)

The most common "I changed it but the old message still shows" case. Three of these override one another — check in this order — and the fourth (**First auto-reply**) is a separate message that is sent on top of them, not an override:

| Field | Where it lives | When it applies |
|---|---|---|
| **Chatbox welcome message** | **Legacy chatbox → General → Welcome Message** | Used only when the AI agent is **off** |
| **AI welcome message** | **AI agent → Settings → AI identity → Welcome message** | Used when the AI agent is **on** — overrides the chatbox one. Supports `{{customer_name}}` |
| **Translated welcome message** | **Settings → Translations → [language] → AI Agent / Live chat** | Each published language keeps its own copy — overrides **both** of the above for visitors in that language |
| **First auto-reply (Online / Offline message)** | **Settings → General → Chat availability → Manage → First auto-reply** | A **separate** automatic first message, not an override. Default online text is "Thank you for reaching out. We'll be with you in a moment"; default offline text is "We are currently offline. We will respond as soon as possible during our next business hours". See `faq_online-hours.md` |

If the AI is enabled, the merchant needs to edit the **AI welcome message**. If they also have translations published, the translated copy is the most common reason an edit "doesn't take" — it must be updated separately. Note a separate **Proactive Chat** campaign message can also appear as a pop-up teaser; that one is edited in the **Proactive chat** section, not here.

**If the merchant quotes "Thank you for reaching out. We'll be with you in a moment" (or a similar
"we'll be with you shortly" line), it is the First auto-reply → Online message** under
**Settings → General → Chat availability → Manage**. Do **not** send them to Human handover: the
**Response time promise** field is set on the **Human handover** scenario — edit it at
**AI agent → Scenarios → Human handover** (the same setting shows as a **Human agent transfer**
status row on **AI agent → Skills → Customer support** — same setting, different page,
different label, see `faq_human-handover.md`) — shown only after a handover to the
"Collect info & follow up by email" destination. Two different messages, two different screens.

**The AI welcome message is the same across every channel.** Website chat, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, and email all use the one AI welcome message (or, for a visitor in a published language, that language's translated version). There is **no setting to configure a different greeting per channel** — you cannot give WhatsApp a different opening line from the website widget. If a merchant wants a distinct greeting for one channel only, the only lever available today is language/translation, not channel; there is no per-channel override.

### "AI Not Using the Identity I Gave It"

If a merchant reports the AI isn't using the identity they configured, start at
**AI agent → Settings** and verify Name/Avatar/Welcome message are saved, and check
**AI agent → Instructions → General instructions → Role** for the persona text. Don't default
to the generic data-source/Instructions-saved troubleshooting used for wrong-answer
cases (see `case_ai-wrong-responses` → *AI Reverts to Default Behavior*) — that flow
is for factual answers, not identity/persona.

## Support Email Addresses

Set a **Contact support email**. The customer contact form and chat history are
sent to this address. Separate multiple emails with commas (,).

## AI Availability — Control When AI Replies

Control when the AI agent replies to customers, based on your team's availability.

Go to **AI agent → Settings → AI availability → Choose when AI replies**, then pick:

- **Always** — AI replies anytime, even when agents are online
- **Only when agents are offline** — AI replies only when no human agents are online

Manage your team's hours in **Chat availability settings**.

**No time-based failover exists.** There is no setting to have the AI automatically take over if a human doesn't reply within N minutes while still inside business hours — availability is schedule-based only (Always vs. Only when agents are offline). Workaround for coverage gaps during working hours: set the online-status display rule (**Settings → Working hours → Online status display**) to treat the team as "offline" whenever no agent is actually online, even inside business hours, so the AI can still catch chats. Log a request for true time-based failover as a feature request if a merchant specifically needs it.

## AI Re-engagement

**AI re-engage after resolution**: When enabled, resolved conversations are reopened
and reassigned to the AI when a customer sends a new message. Respects your AI
availability setting.

## Follow-up Messages

**AI Follow-up**: Automatically sends a follow-up when a customer goes silent during
a conversation, helping recover distracted shoppers.

- **Wait time**: How long to wait after the customer's last message before sending a
  follow-up. Choose from a dropdown: **3 minutes**, **5 minutes (recommended)**,
  **10 minutes**, or **15 minutes** (default: 5 minutes).

## AI Channels

**Out of the box the AI only answers on the online store chat widget.** Every other channel starts
switched off, even after it has been connected successfully. Connecting WhatsApp, Messenger,
Instagram or Email brings the messages into the Inbox, but the AI stays silent on them until that
channel is turned on here as well.

This is the usual explanation for *"the AI replies on my website but not on WhatsApp/Messenger/email"* —
the channel is connected, it just was never added to the list the AI is allowed to answer on. Check
this before treating it as a fault.

Enable the **AI agent to reply** on selected channels: **Email**, **Messenger**,
**Instagram**, and **WhatsApp**. Click **Connect** on each channel to set it up.

The **Pro/Plus** plan gate applies to **AI auto-reply on that channel** — not to
connecting the channel itself. Connecting WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, or Email
is available on **all plans, including Free**; only having the AI respond
automatically on WhatsApp, Messenger, or Instagram requires **Pro or Plus** (see
`case_whatsapp-messenger-issues` and `faq_channels`).

## Embed Product AI Agent

**AI product assistant**: Configure how your AI agent behaves and responds to customer
questions about your products, embedded on your product pages. Use **Go to theme** to
add it (this enables the theme app embed — it does NOT open cart settings). Available
on the **Pro** and **Plus** plans.

Note: there is no separate "Add-to-Cart" toggle or setting. Adding items to the cart is
automatic behavior of the AI product assistant — the AI adds an item when a customer
asks in chat. If a merchant reports the AI isn't adding items to cart, treat it as a
support case (theme compatibility / variant issue), not a setting to enable — see
kb_ai-wrong-responses.

## Embed Homepage AI Agent

**AI agent on Homepage**: Embed the AI chat widget on your homepage so customers can
ask about your store, find products, and get instant AI responses. Use **Go to theme**
to add it. Available on the **Pro** and **Plus** plans.


## AI Agent Actions (AI Doing Real Tasks for a Customer)

**Moved off this page.** These toggles used to live here; they now live at
**AI agent → Skills → Customer support**, alongside Order tracking and Human agent
transfer — see `faq_ai-training-setup` → *AI Capabilities & Limits* for the merchant-facing
summary of what the AI can do.

Since **13/08**, the AI agent can take two limited actions directly on a customer's order/account instead of only collecting info and handing off to a human:

- **Change shipping address** — only on orders that **haven't shipped yet**. Once an order has shipped or been cancelled, the AI cannot change it and will say so, offering a human handover instead.
- **Update email subscription** — opt a customer in or out of marketing emails.

**Setup:** each action is a **separate toggle row** on **AI agent → Skills → Customer support**, both **default OFF**. A merchant must explicitly turn on each one they want the AI to be allowed to do — enabling one does not enable the other.

**Identity check before acting:** the AI only performs the action after the customer clearly confirms it in the preceding message.
- **Logged-in customers** are matched automatically against their account.
- **Guest/anonymous customers** must provide the exact **email or phone number on the order** — if it doesn't match, the AI refuses and does not reveal any order details.

**What the AI still cannot do here:** cancel an unshipped order, or take any account-authentication action (login help, OTP, password reset — see `faq_ai-training-setup` → *AI Capabilities & Limits*). Cancel-order exists in the code as a built action but is **deliberately withheld from release** — it's the one irreversible action (no un-cancel in Shopify) and its refund/restock behavior isn't yet merchant-configurable. A third toggle for AI-initiated password reset was tested but was **removed on 18/08** and is not available to merchants.

**No admin log yet** — there is currently no screen in the app to review what the AI changed on a customer's behalf. If a merchant asks "did the AI actually update my customer's address," this has to be checked with the team; it isn't self-serve yet.

# Human Handover

## Human Handover Overview

Human handover controls when the AI hands a conversation off to your human team and where the customer goes after that. It's a **default scenario** — one that ships with every store, can't be deleted, but can be edited.

> **Same setting, two different labels depending which page you're looking at.**
> The **Scenarios** list (**AI agent → Scenarios**) shows it as **"Human handover"** — that's
> also where you edit it. The **Skills** page (**AI agent → Skills → Customer support**) shows
> the same underlying setting as a status row labeled **"Human agent transfer"** — that's a
> quick on/off + status view, not a separate setting. If a merchant (or a teammate) mentions
> either name, they mean the same thing; don't treat "Human agent transfer" as a new feature.

**To edit it:** go to **AI agent → Scenarios**, find **Human handover** in the default-scenarios
list, and click its **Edit** icon. The edit page has two parts:
1. **When should AI hand off to your team?** — auto triggers + intent rules
2. **Where does the customer go?** — destination + offline behavior

Two action buttons at the top:
- **Restore to default** — reset all handover settings to defaults
- **Test AI** — preview handover behavior without affecting live chat

---

## Auto Triggers — When AI Hands Off Automatically

Under "When should AI hand off to your team?", the **Auto triggers** section lets AI detect customer behavior and transfer automatically. Each trigger can be toggled on or off:

- **Customer asks to talk to a person** — `Always on` (cannot be turned off). AI detects intent like "talk to human", "speak to agent", "real person".
- **AI cannot answer** — auto hand-off after 2 consecutive low-confidence responses.
- **Customer repeats question** — auto hand-off when the same question is asked 2+ times.
- **Negative sentiment** — auto hand-off on frustration or anger, detected from wording, ALL CAPS, repeated punctuation, negative emojis (👎😠⚠️), or 2+ thumb-down reactions on AI replies.

---

## Intent Rules — Custom Transfer Topics

Below the auto triggers, **Intent rules** let the merchant define their own topics. The AI semantically matches the customer's message against these topics and transfers immediately — it does **not** send an AI response first.

To add one, click **+ Add rule** and define the topic.

Use this for topics that should always go straight to a human (e.g. cancellations, wholesale, legal requests).

---

## Where Does the Customer Go?

Under "Where does the customer go?", choose one of three destinations after a handover:

- **Transfer to human in Chatty inbox** (Recommended) — the agent joins the chat directly and the customer stays in the same window, no friction. Agent routing is managed in **Automation settings**; working hours are configured in **Chat availability settings**.
- **Collect info & follow up by email** — no live agents needed. AI collects customer details and sends a summary to your team email. Set a **Response time promise** shown to the customer (e.g. "When we're back online"). Support email addresses are edited in AI settings.
- **Show contact methods** — AI shows the contact methods configured in your **Chatbox settings** (phone, WhatsApp, email, contact form…) and lets the customer pick how to reach out.

---

## Offline Behavior (Transfer to Inbox option)

When the destination is **Transfer to human in Chatty inbox**, configure what happens when the team is offline.

**When your team is offline, show customers:**
- **Leave a message — we'll follow up** — AI collects email + issue description; the team follows up when back online. Set a **Response time promise** shown to the customer.
- **Show contact methods** — AI shows the contact methods configured in Chatbox settings so the customer can reach out while the team is away.

**While the customer waits for your team, let AI keep replying:**
- **Don't allow** — AI stops replying once the customer is waiting for an agent.
- **Allow only outside business hours** — when the team is offline, AI keeps handling the conversation instead of handing off.
- **Allow all the time** — AI keeps replying while the customer waits, even during business hours.

> Working hours are set in **Chat availability settings**.

---

## Custom Confirmation & Staff-Transfer Messages

Merchants can write their own custom text for two handover-related messages instead of using the default wording:

- **Form confirmation messages** — the message shown after a customer submits a form (e.g. the "Collect info & follow up by email" or "Leave a message" flows above).
- **Staff-transfer messages** — the message shown to the customer when a chat is handed over to a human agent.

Both fields have a **500-character limit**, and edits show a **real-time preview** in the settings UI as the merchant types, so they can see exactly how the message will look before saving.

---

## After-Sales Support Skill (Order/Return/Refund Questions)

For merchants who want order-related questions (shipping status, returns, refunds,
"where's my order") to go to a **contact form** instead of the AI asking for
email/order number, the right setting is a different default scenario — **After-sales
support** — not this one.

**Same two-label pattern as Human handover:** the **Scenarios** list (**AI agent →
Scenarios**) shows and edits it as **"After-sales support"**; the **Skills** page
(**AI agent → Skills → Customer support**) shows the same setting's status row as
**"After-sale support"** (singular). Edit at **AI agent → Scenarios → After-sales support**.
It can run in parallel with a merchant's own Custom Scenario on returns/refunds (see
`faq_train-ai`).

Don't route this request through Human handover's "Show contact methods" — that
option is for general handover, not for gating order-related AI questions behind a
contact form.

> The message text shown to the customer around the After-sales contact form is
> **merchant-customizable**, not fixed — it isn't hardcoded copy.

---

# AI Training & Setup

> **Since mid-to-late August 2026, AI agent is a hub page**, not one long settings
> screen — every step below (Training data, Instructions, Skills, Scenarios, Settings)
> is its own top-level page reached by clicking its card from **AI agent**, not a tab
> or a "Manage" button inside a longer page.

## Setting Up AI Training for the First Time

To set up your AI agent, follow these steps:

1. Go to **AI agent** → **Training data** to add training data (Products, Collections, Discounts, Markets, FAQs, Custom knowledge)
2. Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** to add custom instructions for how the AI should respond
3. Go to **AI agent** → **Skills** to turn on what the AI can do (Smart recommendations, Product quiz, Order tracking, Human handover, etc.) and **AI agent** → **Scenarios** for any custom scenario
4. Go to **AI agent** → **Settings** to set the AI name, avatar/logo, welcome message, and re-engagement
5. Click **Test AI** → **Test now** to test responses before going live

Would you like to set this up yourself, or have our team handle the full setup for you, free of charge? They'll train your AI assistant to fit your store, and you can adjust anything afterwards.

**How to answer this:** When a merchant asks how to set up their AI agent, give the setup steps above and the free-setup offer — nothing else. Do **not** add a note that advanced features or data sources require a paid plan; the merchant did not ask about plans, and leading with a paywall discourages setup. Only discuss plans or paid features if the merchant asks about pricing/plans directly, or when a step they want to take needs a feature their current plan doesn't include — at that point name the specific feature and point them to the pricing page. Advanced features that are paid-only: Store Instructions, Scenarios, QnA, and Data Source expansion (this list is for your reference, not for volunteering).

**For high-revenue stores** (ARR > $200K on a paid plan): proactively offer help with initial setup and a demo call with PM.

---

## Restoring Deleted AI Instructions

To recover deleted AI Instructions, contact support team for further help.

---

## Testing AI Responses

Use the built-in **Test** feature — it does **NOT** count against the merchant's AI replies quota.

1. Go to **AI agent** → **Test AI** → **Test now**
2. Enter questions and check AI responses

**Important:** Under the new pricing policy, each plan (except Plus) has limited AI Replies. Do not test directly on the merchant's live chat without permission.

---

## Prevent AI from Sharing Support Email

1. Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **General instructions** → **Behaviours**
2. Add: `Do not provide Store Support Email addresses to customers.`
3. Save the changes
4. Test by asking "How can I contact support?" to confirm the email is no longer shown

---

## Disabling AI Follow-Up Questions

Follow-up questions — the AI suggesting a next question to keep the conversation going — are **off
by default**. A store only sees them if someone turned the *Product question suggestions* scenario on.
Check that first: if a merchant wants them gone, switching that scenario back off is usually all it
takes and they can do it themselves.

If they still appear after that, it has to be switched off for them on our side.

1. Confirm the merchant really wants the AI to answer directly, with no follow-up question
2. Tell them the team will switch it off for them, then hand it over so it can be applied
3. Explain the trade-off: answers get shorter and feel less personal afterwards
4. Once it is done, ask them to test again and confirm it matches what they wanted

---

## AI Showing Wrong Support Email

The AI pulls the support email from **AI agent** → **Settings** → **Support email addresses**.

1. Check which email the AI sent to the customer
2. Go to **AI agent** → **Settings** → **Support email addresses** and check the address set there (separate multiple addresses with commas)
3. If wrong, guide the merchant to update it with the correct one
4. After updating, the AI will automatically use the new email

---

## AI Not Replying to Emails

1. Verify AI email channel is enabled: **AI agent** → **Settings** → **AI Channels** → **Email**
2. AI auto-replies after 5 minutes if no agent responds — only to genuine customer inquiries (not spam or system notifications)
3. If configured correctly but AI still doesn't reply, escalate to the dev team

---

## AI Not Transferring to Human Agents

First check the **Human handover** scenario — edit it at **AI agent → Scenarios → Human handover** (the same setting shows as a **Human agent transfer** status row on **AI agent → Skills → Customer support**; see `faq_human-handover` for the naming note):
- **Auto triggers:** "Customer asks to talk to a person" is always on; "AI cannot answer", "Customer repeats question", and "Negative sentiment" are toggles — confirm the relevant trigger is enabled.
- **Destination:** confirm "Transfer to human in Chatty inbox" is selected (vs. "Collect info & follow up by email" / "Show contact methods").
- **Offline behavior:** if "Allow only outside business hours" / "Allow all the time" is set, AI keeps replying instead of handing off when the team is offline — this is expected.

If handover is configured correctly but the conversation still shows "Unassigned," agent routing is managed in **Automation settings** (check Automatic Assignment / "Reassign conversations"). If still failing, collect conversation details and escalate to TS/dev team.

---

## Hiding Product Preview Card

There is currently **no dedicated app setting** to disable product preview cards. The preview card shares CSS with the "Reply to" element — hiding via CSS would hide both.

- If merchant doesn't want AI to sell → suggest adjusting AI to focus on support skills instead
- If concerned about cluttered UI → explain the CSS limitation
- If they need more control → log feedback and escalate to the product team

---

## AI Responds Before Pre-Chat Form

This happens when customers interact via the **AI Product Assistant** on the product page — it prioritizes quick answers without requiring customer info first.

If the merchant's priority is collecting customer info before any response, they should hide the **AI Product Assistant** on the storefront and rely solely on the pre-chat form.

---

## Creating an AI Scenario

Go to **AI agent** → **Scenarios**, then click **+ Add scenario** and define:

1. **Scenario name** — the topic your customers mention
2. **Instructions** — the messages or flow you want the AI to follow

Use this for returns, order lookups, discount requests, or any specific process you want the AI to handle consistently.

---

## AI Product Sync Limits

| Plan | Product limit |
|------|--------------|
| Free | 200 products |
| Basic | 1,500 products |
| Pro | 8,000 products |
| Plus | Unlimited |

If the store exceeds the plan limit, Chatty trains on the most recently updated products first. For stores with more than 5,000 products, contact support — this requires manual backend configuration.

### "It won't upload all my products" / products missing from the list

If products are missing in **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Products**, check in this order:
1. **Deactivated products** — products toggled off in the list won't train; toggle them **Active**.
2. **A search or filter is hiding them** — clear any active search/filter.
3. **Header says "X of X products learned" but the list shows "No items found"** — clear the filter and switch to the **All** tab. If the list is still empty, escalate as a **display bug** (collect store URL + a screenshot).

---

## AI Product Inventory Sync

Chatty syncs product data including inventory status from Shopify. However, **real-time automatic stock quantity updates are not supported**.

To sync the latest data manually: **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Products** → click **Sync products**.

**Out-of-stock products are still learned.** The AI does train on products that are out of stock (as long as they are **Active** in Training data) — it does not skip them. When a customer asks about an out-of-stock item, the AI answers about the product and states that it is currently out of stock; it does not pretend the product doesn't exist. To stop the AI from answering about a specific item entirely, toggle that product **off (Disabled)** in **AI agent → Training data → Products**.

---

## Training Data Language

The AI performs best with training data in the same language your customers use. For multilingual audiences, you can add training data in multiple languages.

Avoid mixing languages in a single FAQ entry — it may reduce accuracy.

---

## Multilingual Product Descriptions

Chatty's AI reads Shopify product descriptions as written. If descriptions are available in multiple languages, the AI can answer in those languages.

For best results, ensure each product has complete descriptions in all supported languages. You can also add multilingual FAQs manually in **AI agent** → **Training data** → **FAQs**.

---

## AI Page Context Detection

Yes — Chatty automatically detects the current page URL and product context. When a customer asks a question on a product page, the AI uses that product's information to answer.

Make sure the **Smart recommendations** skill is enabled under **AI agent** → **Skills** → **Shopping** (this skill was renamed from "Product recommendations" — same toggle).

---

## Collection-Based Product Recommendations

Yes — if the AI detects the customer is on a product or collection page, it can use that context to make relevant recommendations.

Make sure **Products** data is enabled in **Training data**. Use collection-specific scenarios to further improve accuracy.

---

## Prevent AI from Sharing Phone Number

1. Go to **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Custom knowledge** and remove/replace any phone number mentions with a redirect message: `For phone inquiries, please contact us via email.`
2. Create a **Custom scenario** (**AI agent** → **Scenarios**): `Do not share the store phone number. Direct customers to contact us via email instead.`

---

## AI Shared an Unwanted Private Detail (Address, Personal Email, Other PII)

The AI only shares what's in its training data or settings — trace the source first. Open the offending answer → **Review Sources**; in real cases handled, the source has been either a merchant-added FAQ containing the detail, or the **Support email** field under **AI agent → Instructions**.

1. Remove or edit the entry containing the private detail.
2. Replace it with the contact information the merchant *does* want shared.
3. Add a boundary instruction under **AI agent → Instructions** covering that category of information (e.g. "Never share personal staff contact details or home addresses.").
4. Retest with a few phrasings to confirm it no longer surfaces.

If the merchant can't locate the source themselves, offer to make the change and verify it for them.

---

## Can the AI Read Images or Documents a Customer Sends?

The AI can match a **product photo** a customer sends against the synced catalog and reply about that specific product. It **cannot read or interpret uploaded documents** — PDFs, reports, forms, or other files sent by a customer in chat — and shouldn't be relied on for anything requiring document interpretation. Route those to a human via a **Human handover** intent rule.

(This is separate from a merchant *uploading* a PDF/CSV as training data under Custom knowledge — see the format table above; that's about feeding the AI's own knowledge, not about the AI reading files customers send mid-chat.)

---

## Best AI Training Content

Include:
- **Accurate product descriptions** with measurements, materials, and key specifications
- **FAQs** covering common questions (shipping, returns, sizing, payments)
- **Custom Scenarios** for specific flows like order status, discount codes, return requests

Keep content clear, avoid conflicting information, and update regularly as products or policies change.

---

## Size Recommendation Setup

**Size guide is a built-in default scenario now** — turn it on at **AI agent → Skills →
Shopping → Size guide**, or edit its content at **AI agent → Scenarios → Size guide**.
It's gated to **Pro or Plus** (the in-app upgrade badge on this row reads "Advanced
plan" — that's just the badge wording, the actual plan requirement is Pro/Plus, same
tier as Product quiz).

Make sure product descriptions include clear size/measurement information — the built-in
scenario references your existing size chart content.

**If a merchant wants trigger phrasing beyond the built-in scenario** (e.g. a specific
brand-voice response), add a separate **Custom Scenario** at **AI agent → Scenarios →
+ Add scenario** with triggers like `what size`, `size guide`, `how does it fit`, and
instructions guiding the AI to refer to the size chart or the size guide page.

---

## AI Giving Wrong Product Links

This usually means the AI matched a query to incorrect backend data (e.g., a collection lookup). Contact support with the **conversation ID** — the team will add an instruction hook to fix the response logic.

As a preventive step, ensure product descriptions are detailed and unambiguous.

---

## Product FAQs and "View Similar" Recommendations

No — product FAQs do **not** influence the "View Similar" recommendation feature. Recommendations are handled through **Smart Recommendations** settings, not FAQ data.

---

## Plan Product Limit Too Low

Each plan has a product sync limit (Free: 200, Basic: 1,500, Pro: 8,000, Plus: Unlimited). If you've hit the limit:

- Contact support and share what you need — the team will review and confirm if a one-time extension is possible (subject to approval)
- For permanent higher limits, upgrade your plan
- If you have more than 5,000 products, contact support directly — this requires manual backend configuration

---

## AI Using Wrong Store's Catalog

Contact support with the **conversation ID**. This is typically caused by the AI matching against backend collection data incorrectly. The team will add an instruction hook to prevent this behavior.

**Milder version — AI references product counts/categories that don't match what's actually synced, but the catalog is still the merchant's own store:** the same fix applies. Contact support with the **conversation ID** so the team can trace why the AI's referenced numbers diverge from **AI agent → Training data → Products**; don't assume it's the wrong-store issue above just because the catalog is stale-looking.

---

## AI and Website Content

**Note:** This applies to external websites only. Shopify store pages (About us, Shipping policy, Return policy, Privacy policy, Terms of service, FAQ, Contact us) are automatically synced — no URL submission needed for these.

For external websites: No — the AI does **not** automatically read your website. You must submit specific page URLs to the **Custom Knowledge** section.

Submitting just the domain (e.g., `yourstore.com`) only trains on the homepage content — submit individual page URLs for full coverage.

---

## What AI Model Does Chatty Use — Can I Use OpenAI / Switch the Model?

Chatty runs on a **secure, enterprise-grade large language model built for support**, upgraded regularly. The specific underlying model is not publicly disclosed, and the AI agent layer on top of it is optimized for e-commerce support scenarios.

**There is no option to plug in OpenAI or swap the underlying model** — not on any plan.

**If a merchant feels the replies are weak, the fix is almost always data/instruction quality, not the model:**
1. Turn on the relevant **Skills** — **AI agent → Skills**
2. Tighten the **General instructions** (**AI agent → Instructions**) and add **Custom scenarios** (**AI agent → Scenarios**) for the cases they're unhappy with
3. Add **Custom knowledge** for anything the AI is missing
4. Re-test in **AI agent → Test AI → Test now** with the exact question that failed

Ask for the **specific example** that disappointed them — that is what makes the fix possible, and it's what the product team needs.

**Log the OpenAI / model-choice request as a feature request** with the merchant's use case and their example.

---

## AI Responding in Wrong Language

The AI is designed to respond in the customer's language. If it's getting confused (especially for very short or ambiguous messages), contact support with the **conversation ID**. The team can add an explicit instruction: `Always reply in the same language the customer is using.`

---

## AI Repeating Auto-Reply FAQ Content

This is a **known bug**. Contact support with the **conversation ID** — the dev team can investigate and fix the response logic so the AI does not repeat content already shown in the auto-reply.

---

## Suppressing Add-to-Cart Button

Scenario Instructions can set behavioral guidelines, but the Add-to-Cart button is a **system-level behavior** — it cannot be suppressed via scenario alone.

Contact support — the team can apply a custom instruction or CSS/code solution.

---

## AI Always Providing Contact Phone Number

Two approaches:
1. Add the phone number to **General AI Instructions** so the AI references it broadly
2. Create a **Custom Scenario** (**AI agent** → **Scenarios** → **+ Add scenario**) triggered when customers ask about contacting the team

---

## AI Points to a Generic Contact Page / Wrong Contact URL

**Symptom:** the AI replies with a vague *"you can reach us via our contact page"* — with the wrong link, or no link at all.

**Fix:** add the merchant's **exact contact URL** to **AI agent → Instructions → General instructions** (or to Custom knowledge), so the AI references the right page instead of guessing. Re-test in **AI agent → Test AI**.

**If the merchant wants an on-store form rather than a link:**
- Chatty has a **built-in Contact form** section — it displays when a customer requests human/after-sales support. Submissions land in the **Inbox** and are also forwarded to the address set in **AI agent → Settings → Contact support email**.
- Chatty also integrates with **Powerful Contact Form** — set up in **Settings → Integrations** (see `faq_powerful-contact-form`). Each submission becomes a conversation in the inbox.

---

## AI and Loyalty Points / Customer Account Data

No — Chatty AI **cannot** access customer account data (login status, loyalty points balance, etc.).

As a workaround, create a **Custom Scenario** that directs customers to your login/registration page when they ask about rewards or account-specific questions.

---

## Custom Scenario Character Limit

Currently the character limit for individual scenario fields **cannot be increased**. Contact support — the team can help optimize and shorten the scenario text to fit within the limit.

**This is different from the Instructions field cap** (AI agent → Instructions → General instructions): that field has a **~1,000-character limit and support cannot raise it** — an overloaded prompt risks the AI drifting or hallucinating. If a merchant is out of room in Instructions, suggest moving facts out instead: Instructions should describe *behaviour* (tone, boundaries, routing); product details, policies and reference info belong in **Training data → Custom knowledge**, which has a far more generous limit.

The **welcome/offline chatbox message fields** are a third, separate cap that is fixed and cannot be raised — see `faq_chatbox-settings.md`.

---

## AI and Shopify Metafields

Only **standard / supported** metafield types are synced to the AI. You can see and toggle which metafields are synced at **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Products** → **Manage metafields**.

**Not supported:** Non-standard / third-party **custom metafields** (for example, metafields created via a separate metafields app) are **not currently synced** — only the supported metafield types sync. Metaobject references (metafields that reference other metaobjects) are also not yet fully supported.

**Workaround:** Add that data into **Custom knowledge** as a Q&A so the AI can still use it. If supporting a specific metafield type matters to the store, log a **feature request** with the merchant's use case so the product team can prioritize it.

---

## AI Says "No Access" to Product Specs, Size Charts, or FAQ Metafields

When the AI replies "I don't have access to that information" even though the data is on your product pages, work through these:

1. Confirm the product is **Active** in **AI agent → Training data → Products** and that sync has finished (it can lag a few minutes after install/upload).
2. Standard product fields (title, description, variants, price, availability) and **supported metafields** sync — toggle them in **Products → Manage metafields**. However, **product-page "FAQ" / spec metafields and many third-party/custom metafields are not reliably indexed today**, so technical specs stored only in those tabs may not reach the AI. Re-enter those facts as text in **Custom knowledge** (Q&A) or a CSV.
3. **Images are not read.** A **size chart saved as an image won't be parsed** — re-enter that data as text in Custom knowledge or a CSV; don't rely on an image.
4. For FAQ/Q&A content, make sure the topic is **Active** and the question is phrased plainly.

As a catch-all, put the missing facts into **Custom knowledge** and re-test in **Test AI**. If correctly-synced data still isn't used, send the **conversation ID** so the team can trace it (FAQ/custom-metafield sync is a known coverage gap and can be logged as a feature request).

## Uploading Files for AI Training

Go to **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Custom knowledge** → **Add data** → **Files**.

| Format | Notes |
|--------|-------|
| PDF | Supported; not ideal for structured data |
| CSV | **Recommended** for product catalogs and structured Q&A |
| TXT | Supported |
| JSON | Supported |

- Max file size: **2MB per file**
- For large product catalogs → CSV gives better results than PDF
- AI uses RAG — similar customer questions match the closest trained entry

---

## AI Language Switching / Wrong Language Response

1. Go to **Settings → Translation** → confirm the correct **default language** is set
2. Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **General instructions** → **Behaviours** → add:
   > *"Always respond in the same language as the customer."*
3. For real-time translation between agent and customer in the inbox → requires **Pro or Plus plan**

> Free/Basic plans: AI responds based on training data language + customer input. Explicit instruction in step 2 is the most effective fix.

---

## Setting AI Brand Voice / Tone

Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **General instructions** → **Communication style** or **Behaviours**, and add brand tone guidelines. Examples:

- *"You are a friendly assistant for [Brand]. Use warm, casual language."*
- *"Never say 'I apologize' — say 'I'm sorry' instead."*
- *"Write in UK English. Use formal but approachable language."*
- *"Keep responses concise — no more than 3 sentences unless the question requires detail."*

Many merchants skip the Instructions setup entirely — if AI sounds generic, this is the first thing to configure.

---

## Disabling AI Product Recommendations

**Option 1 — Toggle Smart Recommendations off:**
Go to **AI agent** → **Skills** → **Shopping** → **Smart recommendations** → Toggle **OFF**

**Option 2 — Custom Instruction:**
Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **General instructions** → **Behaviours** and add: *"Do not recommend products unless the customer explicitly asks for a recommendation."*

> Product recommendations is a **Pro+ feature**. On lower plans, AI uses general product sync — disable via Behaviours instructions.

---

## Changing AI Bot Name / Welcome Message / Avatar

The AI's **display name** — the name customers see on the AI's messages — is set at
**AI agent** → **Settings** → **Name**. The avatar and welcome message live in the same
place, under **AI agent** → **Settings** → **AI identity**.

Tone and self-description are configured separately, at **AI agent** → **Instructions** →
**Manage** → **General instructions**:

- **Role** → describe who the assistant is and how it presents itself (max 250 chars)
- **Communication style** → choose Friendly / Professional / Empathetic / Custom
- **Behaviours** → customize conversation style (max 1000 chars)

Changes apply immediately. No republishing required.

> Editing **Role** changes how the AI describes itself, not the name shown on its
> messages. To rename the assistant, change **AI agent → Settings → Name**.
> See `faq_ai-agent-settings` for the full breakdown.

---

## AI Capabilities & Limits (What It Can and Cannot Do)

For feasibility questions — "can the AI do X for us" — Chatty's AI agent **can**: answer from trained product/FAQ/custom content, do guided product recommendations, run scenario-based flows (**AI agent → Scenarios**), hand off to a human via **Human handover** (**AI agent → Scenarios → Human handover**, also shown as **Human agent transfer** on **AI agent → Skills → Customer support**), and — since **13/08** — take two limited actions directly on an order/customer record when the merchant has turned them on at **AI agent → Skills → Customer support** (see `faq_ai-agent-settings` → *AI Agent Actions*): updating the shipping address on an unshipped order, and toggling a customer's marketing email subscription.

**It cannot:**
- Call third-party APIs at runtime (beyond Chatty's own built-in integrations)
- Generate documents (PDFs, contracts, invoices, etc.)
- Host or join live video sessions
- Handle account-level authentication flows inside the chat (login, OTP, password reset) — this includes resetting a customer's password; a "Send password reset" capability was tested but removed on **18/08** and is not available

If a merchant's request needs any of the above, tell them upfront it's out of scope rather than promising a workaround — log it as a feature request if it's a recurring ask.

# Train AI

## AI Training Overview

AI training is the process of teaching your AI agent to understand your business and respond accurately to customer questions. High-quality, relevant data produces the best results.

## Step 1: Plan Your Training Content

Organize information into categories before you start adding data:

| Content category | What to include | How to add |
|---|---|---|
| Product information | Details, specs, variants, pricing | Sync products; add FAQs per product |
| Store information | Business hours, contact details, locations | Sync store data |
| Shipping & delivery | Methods, costs, delivery times | Sync FAQs or add custom Q&A |
| Returns & refunds | Policy details, steps, timeframes | Sync FAQs or add custom Q&A |
| Product-specific topics | Care instructions, warranties, compatibility | Add Q&A to custom data source or per product |
| Special scenarios | Holiday shipping, seasonal sales, event policies | Go to **AI agent** → **Scenarios** → **+ Add scenario** |

## Step 2: Best Practices per Data Source

**Products:**
- Write detailed product descriptions with specifications
- Use consistent naming for variants
- Keep pricing updated
- For specific product recommendations, set up **Smart recommendations** (renamed from "Product recommendations") under **AI agent** → **Skills** → **Shopping**

If you sync Markets data, AI can answer region-specific questions about pricing and availability, and send product links with regional variations.

**Limitations to be aware of:**
- AI cannot identify bestsellers without **Smart recommendations** configured under **AI agent → Skills → Shopping**
- AI can only suggest complementary products if they're mentioned in product descriptions

---

## Step 3: Add Custom Instructions

After adding data sources, customize how AI communicates:

- **Name & avatar**: How your bot appears to customers
- **Welcome message**: First message in chat
- **Custom instructions**: AI's personality, tone, role, and response boundaries (**AI agent → Instructions**)
- **AI skills**: Shopping and customer support skills — now its own page, **AI agent → Skills**, separate from Instructions

## Step 4: Add Scenario Instructions

Scenario instructions train AI to handle specific situations when customers use certain keywords. Custom scenarios also live on their own page now, separate from both Instructions and Skills.

**How to add a scenario:**

1. Go to **AI agent → Scenarios**
2. **Name your scenario** — e.g., "Product return request", "Shipping delays"
3. **Set keywords** — words that trigger this scenario (include variations and synonyms): e.g., "refund", "return", "money back", "send back"
4. **Write instructions** — specific guidance for AI when this scenario triggers (max 1000 characters)
5. **Set status** — Active or Inactive

**Common scenarios to set up:**
- Product recommendations
- Order returns and refunds
- Shipping inquiries
- Complaint handling
- Promotional offers
- Technical support

**Example scenario — Customer expressing strong dissatisfaction:**

Instructions:
1. Acknowledge frustration: "I understand how disappointing this must be"
2. Apologize sincerely
3. Offer immediate solutions: refund, exchange, or store credit
4. Escalate to human: connect with a team member who can resolve this personally
5. Never argue — focus only on solutions

---

---

## Custom Scenario Overridden by a Built-in Assistant Skill

If a merchant adds a Custom Scenario or a general instruction telling the AI **not** to do something on a topic (e.g. "don't offer to submit a return claim"), and the AI keeps doing it anyway, check whether a **built-in default scenario** covering the same topic is also active — for example, **After-sales support** (edit at **AI agent → Scenarios → After-sales support**; shown as **After-sale support** — singular — on **AI agent → Skills → Customer support**, see `faq_human-handover` for the naming note) can run in parallel with a merchant's own Custom Scenario on returns/refunds, and the built-in skill can win out over the custom instruction.

**How to diagnose:** use **Review sources** on the offending answer to see whether it came from the Custom Scenario or from a built-in skill.

**How to fix:** either turn off the overlapping built-in skill so only the Custom Scenario governs that topic, or edit the Custom Scenario/instruction to explicitly account for the built-in skill's behavior. Don't assume adding a stronger-worded instruction will fix it — if a built-in skill is answering first, wording changes to the custom instruction won't help until the conflict itself is resolved.

## How to Write Good Custom Instructions

Yes — custom instructions let you shape AI's personality, role, response style, and what it should or shouldn't say.

**Structure your instructions clearly, for example:**

```
ROLE:
- Act as a helpful customer support associate for [Store Name]
- Refer to yourself as "I" and the store as "we"

KNOWLEDGE:
- You know about our products, policies, and pricing
- If you don't know something, say so and suggest contacting our team

APPROACH:
- Keep responses conversational but professional
- Include product details (dimensions, materials, colors) when relevant
- Suggest complementary products when appropriate

AVOID:
- Don't make definitive claims about exact stock levels
- Don't promise specific delivery dates
- Don't make up product specifications
```

You can manually write instructions or use the **Generate with AI** button to create a starting point based on your business type.

# Product Quiz

## What the Product Quiz Feature Is

Chatty has an **AI-powered Product Quiz** — a quiz-style interaction that recommends products to customers based on their answers. This is new, and distinct from static product recommendations (e.g. recommendation cards/campaigns) since it's interactive and adapts based on customer input.

## Where to Turn It On

Toggle it at **AI agent → Skills → Shopping → Product quiz**. Its content/configuration
opens from the same row (edit link goes to **AI agent → Scenarios → Product quiz**).

## Plan Availability

Product Quiz requires the **Pro or Plus plan**. It is not available on Free or Basic.
(The in-app upgrade badge on this row may read "Advanced plan" — that's just the badge
wording, not a different plan tier; the actual gate is Pro/Plus, same as Size guide.)

For setup steps beyond what's covered here, escalate to support.
